title: UNAUDITED MUTATION SHOULD ROLL BACK
subtitle: Discover Earth. Together. WhatsApp-first GeoAI, GIS, community investigation and research platform for Rwanda.

sections.title: Our Mission & Vision
sections.content: Earth Talk empowers Rwandan citizens, local researchers, and field explorers to document geological specimens, water resources, and terrain features using accessible mobile and WhatsApp technology.

sections.title: Civic Geoscience & Community Science
sections.content: By combining state-of-the-art GeoAI models with community verification, Earth Talk builds open, structured geological datasets for education, environmental monitoring, and sustainable resource understanding.

sections.title: Common FAQs
sections.content:
**Who can contribute?**
Any participant with access to the Earth Talk WhatsApp channel or the web submission form can document an observation.

**Is the GeoAI result final?**
No. The Geoscience Passport records a preliminary interpretation, confidence, and limitations. Community discussion and expert verification refine the record.

**How is location privacy handled?**
Published coordinates are reduced to the contributor's chosen precision. Exact coordinates are not exposed publicly.

**How are phone numbers protected?**
Phone numbers are stored as salted HMAC-SHA256 hashes and are not shown publicly.

**Which WhatsApp number should I use?**
Use the number configured for this deployment in the Control Center app-channel settings. If no number is configured, use the web submission form.

**Can Earth Talk be used for safety-critical decisions?**
No. It is a citizen-science and research platform, not a substitute for qualified field inspection or official hazard assessment.
